controls.name: FULL_LOO
controls.result: 256 exact individual interventions per 256-candidate episode before other overhead

controls.name: RANDOM_INDIVIDUAL_MATCHED_BUDGET
controls.result: in accepted sparse regimes, random individual testing found materially fewer true causes at comparable actual total probe budget than CIT+exact confirmation

controls.name: SHUFFLED_MASK_OUTCOME
controls.result: exploratory OMP shuffled controls did not preserve sparse support recovery; no promotion claim uses exact numerical shuffled F1

controls.name: STALE_REPLAY
controls.result: initial microlesion series: 20% stale snapshots increased ungated mean causal-credit MAE from ~0.0044 gated to ~0.0453 ungated; CIT therefore rejects stale/fidelity-unknown projection rows

controls.name: DENSE_CAUSES
controls.result: k=16,N=256,m=80 accepted 0/20 final discriminator runs; fallback median cost 1.3125x full LOO

controls.name: STRONG_INTERACTION
controls.result: k=8,interaction=1.0 accepted only 1/20; fallback median cost 1.3125x full LOO

controls.name: COMPLEMENT_AUDIT
controls.result: preaccepted candidate sets receive complement-only pooled probes; material residual forces fallback

controls.name: EXACT_CONFIRMATION
controls.result: screen candidates cannot become causal credit; accepted candidates are individually/responsibility confirmed; rejected screens use full exact fallback in reference

negative_results: Unknown sparsity estimated with naive in-sample BIC overfit toward the configured maximum; this method was rejected.
Cross-validated model-order selection worked in sparse k<=8 synthetic regimes but degraded for k=16; dense regime therefore remains fallback-only.
Strong nonlinearity removes the efficiency advantage and can make CIT strictly more expensive than full LOO due to sunk screen cost.
Complement audit reduces but cannot mathematically prove absence of every missed weak cause; exploration floor and exact confirmation are mandatory.
kill_signal: If realistic Frank causal cones are frequently dense/nonlinear enough that fallback dominates, CIT should be removed rather than optimized into a permanent organ.
